title: Counting at arbitrary density: violation histograms and graded contraction
objective: Extend the bounded-density graded counts of SR-07 toward arbitrary density, conditional on the preprint's Theorem C.1: decide whether Theorem C.1 holds with a second passive grading variable, which would give weight enumerators of satisfying assignments at every density, or identify the precise step of Appendix C that fails; separately record why violation histograms (exact Max-k-SAT) do not follow from the arbitrary-density network and what an exact dense Max-2-SAT algorithm would additionally need.
deliverables: A line-by-line check of Appendix C's hypotheses for a network with two passive variables, with every changed inequality written out
Either a conditional theorem (with its dependence on Theorem C.1 stated) or the exact failing step with a small explicit network showing it
An exact small-instance checker comparing graded counts with brute force
A separate critic's verdict and an updated SR-09 coverage map
success_criteria: Every claim that depends on the unverified upstream theorem is labelled conditional
Small-instance checks are exact and reproducible from a committed script
The dense Max-2-SAT question is reported as open unless an actual algorithm and proof survive review
stop_conditions: Appendix C turns out to rely on a step the working group disputes; stop and record it
No paid provider calls, publication or external contact beyond the user-authorized repository work
